Hi Ivan — quick answers below and Marissa will expand on the HSM details.

1) Customer-managed keys (BYOK): Yes — Redwood supports BYOK in the sense that customers can provision keys in their cloud KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure KeyVault) and grant Redwood the necessary decrypt/encrypt permissions with key policies. You retain lifecycle control (rotate/disable/revoke). We recommend a dedicated key per environment and provide guidance on least-privilege IAM policies.

2) HSM-backed keys: For our hosted Dedicated offering we integrate with cloud HSMs (AWS CloudHSM, Google Cloud HSM) and customers can use key material that is HSM-protected. For Private/on-prem deployments we support HSM appliances and can work with FIPS 140-2 Level 3 devices depending on procurement — Marissa, can you confirm common vendor support and whether we provide any appliance-level integration docs?

3) SOC 2 report: the attached SOC 2 Type II includes scope (production services only) and a controls matrix. If your auditors need a bridge letter or a more detailed control narrative, we can request that from our compliance team — happy to facilitate.

Next steps: Marissa to propose a 30-min technical call to review key provisioning, sample IAM policies, and a short integration checklist. Ivan — does Thursday morning PST work?

Thanks,
Neha

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Hi Ivan — happy to jump on a technical call. A few technical notes in advance: 

- BYOK model: We use envelope encryption. Customer CMK in KMS is used to encrypt/decrypt a data encryption key (DEK) that Redwood controls per-tenant. This means you keep control of the master key, and we never persist raw key material.
- Permissions: For AWS, recommended minimal policy is kms:Decrypt, kms:Encrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey on the CMK resource. We provide Terraform snippets and a sample IAM policy during the call.
- HSMs: For hosted Dedicated we integrate with AWS CloudHSM and can configure the HSM cluster in a customer VPC. For on-prem we support Thales and Utimaco appliances (FIPS 140-2 Level 3) — procurement lead time varies. We do not ship appliances ourselves but provide integration documentation and support during setup.
- Key rotation: Supporting customer rotation is supported — the envelope pattern allows rotation without data re-encryption if new DEKs are generated under the new CMK per best practice.

I'll attach a short KMS integration checklist and sample IAM/Terraform snippets after the call. Proposed times for a 30-min call: Thu 27 Aug 10:00-10:30 PST or Fri 28 Aug 08:00-08:30 PST. Let me know what works and I will send a calendar invite.

Cheers,
